_note: Build Menu categories: one button each in the bottom toolbar, left to right; picking one opens its buildings in the Build panel above it. A building shows under the category named by "menu_tab" in buildings.json (no menu_tab = never in the menu). Buildings with buildable=false show as locked. Categories with no buildings are hidden. icon = a file in assets/ui/icons/; color = the category's square in the panel header (the map's colours); about = the line at the right of the header; divider_before = a thin line before this button in the toolbar.
